smallest_nonproduction_diagnostic.recommendation: Do not rerun or add test sizes. On a capped/failed run, inspect the retained stage directory read-only: family file set/sizes, Parquet footer row/row-group counts, I02 SQLite temp/journal sizes, and BUILD_STAGES/BUILD_SAMPLES. This localizes the family/sink boundary and proof-vs-publish boundary without product edit.
smallest_nonproduction_diagnostic.to_distinguish_sink_vs_proof: A separate nonproduction harness would need to wrap the existing writer's `tap`, `_Sink.flush`, and `build_sourcefree_direct_i02` call boundaries; no such counters exist in the current writer. This is a measurement handoff, not a product optimization.
smallest_nonproduction_diagnostic.existing_optimization_handoff: No writer optimization is justified by current evidence. The existing writer uses bounded 512-row groups, zstd, one-pass family taps and a single I02 proof build; changing chunking/compression or splitting proof/write phases requires an owner-granted writer change after timing.
